meta.ogTitle: Our Story: why we created Noor Phonetic Quran
meta.ogDescription: It all started with meeting a sister who had just converted to Islam and couldn't read the Quran in Arabic. Here's why and how Noor Phonetic Quran was born.

hero.title: Our Story
hero.subtitle: How meeting a sister who had just converted to Islam gave birth to Noor Phonetic Quran.
hero.imageAlt: A new Muslim convert surrounded by friends helping her read the Quran, with the Noor Phonetic Quran app on her phone, symbolizing the mutual support that inspired the app's creation

story.title: A meeting that changed everything
paragraphs: It all started in a very simple, almost ordinary way: meeting a sister who had just converted to Islam. She was full of enthusiasm and sincerity in her new faith, but she also carried a quiet frustration that she eventually confided in us.

She told us about her struggle with the Arabic language. She wanted with all her heart to read the Quran, to understand it, to recite it, but the Arabic alphabet was completely foreign to her. Every attempt at reading turned into a discouraging exercise: she couldn't recognize the letters, didn't know where to pause, and was never sure she was pronouncing the words correctly.

She said something that stayed with us: she felt like the Quran, this book she already cherished with her whole heart, remained "closed" to her, like a treasure she didn't have the key to. She wasn't alone in this: she knew other new Muslims going through the exact same struggle, that same feeling of exclusion from a text they loved but couldn't yet read.

That conversation moved us deeply. We realized this wasn't an isolated case, but a real obstacle faced by countless people around the world: recent converts, but also Muslims born into non-Arabic-speaking families, children, people who had grown distant from their roots over the years. All of them shared the same sincere desire: to read and understand the Quran, without necessarily mastering the Arabic alphabet overnight.

It was from this realization that the idea of Noor Phonetic Quran was born. We decided to create an app that transcribes every verse of the Quran phonetically, verse by verse, so that anyone could start reading and reciting from day one, while gradually learning the rules of pronunciation and Tajweed. Our goal was never to replace learning Arabic, but to remove the first barrier, the one that keeps people from starting, so that reading the Quran could finally become accessible to this sister, and to our entire community.

Since then, what began as an answer to one person's struggle has grown into an app used by tens of thousands of Muslims around the world, in more than 20 languages. But the spirit remains the same as on day one: to build, with humility and sincerity, the tool that sister would have loved to have in her hands.

items.title: Removing the first barrier
items.text: Not knowing how to read Arabic should never stop someone from reading and reciting the Quran. Our phonetics exist to open that door, from day one.

items.title: Supporting, not replacing

items.title: Free and accessible

collect.heading: WHAT INFORMATION DO WE COLLECT?
collect.disclosedTitle: Personal information you disclose to us
collect.disclosedIntro: In Short: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us, for example when you create an account, use recitation correction, or our contact form.
collect.disclosedContact: If you contact us through the contact form built into the app, we collect your name, email address, and the content of your message, along with associated technical information (platform, language, app version, device type, time zone) so we can respond to you and diagnose any issues.
collect.disclosedAccount: If you create an optional account, we collect your email address (email sign-in) or the information transmitted by Google or Apple when signing in through these services (account identifier, name, and email address if you choose to share them), in order to create and secure your profile and to sync your progress and your Premium subscription.
collect.audioIntro: In Short: If you use recitation correction, your voice recording is securely sent to our servers (Google Firebase Storage) so it can be analyzed and/or reviewed by an examiner.
collect.audioDetail: Voice may be considered biometric or sensitive data depending on applicable regulations. When you use the recitation correction feature, your audio recording is stored in a space dedicated to your account (Google Firebase Storage), accessible only to you and to examiners authorized to process your submission, solely to provide you with feedback on your pronunciation. These recordings are not used for advertising purposes and are not shared with third parties beyond the technical providers necessary for their storage (Google Firebase). You may request deletion of your recordings at any time by contacting us (see the "How can you contact us" section).
collect.autoIntro: Like most apps, Noor Phonetic Quran uses third-party technical services that automatically collect certain usage and device data:

analytics.purpose: Audience and feature usage measurement (screens viewed, in-app actions such as reading, memorization, or quizzes), in aggregated and anonymized form
analytics.data: Advertising/installation identifier, usage statistics, language, premium status

crashlytics.purpose: Technical diagnosis of app crashes in order to fix bugs
crashlytics.data: Crash reports, technical information about the device and operating system

auth.purpose: Creation and security of your optional account (email, Google, Apple), syncing of your progress and subscription
auth.data: Email address, account identifier, sign-in method used

storage.purpose: Secure storage of your audio recordings if you use recitation correction
storage.data: Audio files of your voice, associated with your account identifier

purchases.purpose: Management of the premium subscription (ad removal)
purchases.data: Purchase status and identifier, managed directly by Google/Apple

admob.purpose: Display of ads for non-premium users (banners, interstitials) as well as rewarded ads that you may choose to watch voluntarily to support us without subscribing to Premium
admob.data: Device advertising identifier, ad interaction data

collect.att: On iOS, the display of personalized ads may come with an "App Tracking Transparency" (ATT) permission request from the operating system. You can decline this permission at any time from your device's privacy settings (Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking); the app remains fully functional if you decline.
collect.noLocation: We do not collect your precise location; the app does not request location access permission.

process.heading: HOW DO WE PROCESS YOUR INFORMATION?
process.summary: In Short: We process your information to operate the app, respond to your requests, improve our Services, and manage your subscription where applicable.
process.detail: We process the data described above in order to: (i) provide and maintain the app's features (reading, memorization, khatma, quizzes, recitation correction), (ii) respond to messages you send through the contact form, (iii) diagnose and fix technical issues, (iv) measure aggregate feature usage to prioritize our development efforts, (v) manage the premium subscription and ad display for non-premium users.

legal.heading: WHAT LEGAL BASES DO WE RELY ON TO PROCESS YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION?
legal.summary: In Short: We only process your personal information when we believe it is necessary and we have a valid legal reason (i.e., a legal basis) to do so under applicable law.
legal.euTitle: If you are located in the EU or the UK, this section applies to you.
legal.euIntro: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the UK GDPR require us to explain the valid legal bases we rely on to process your personal information:

euList.consent: Consent: for the display of personalized ads and audience measurement, collected via the consent banner on first launch of the app.
euList.contract: Performance of a contract: for the management of your premium subscription.
euList.legitimate: Legitimate interest: for technical diagnostics (Crashlytics) and processing your contact messages.

legal.canadaTitle: If you are located in Canada, this section applies to you.
legal.canadaText: We may process your information if you have given us specific permission, or in certain legally defined cases (privacy law). We may also process your information where it is reasonable and for purposes that a reasonable person would consider appropriate, for example to respond to your contact requests.

share.heading: WHEN AND WITH WHOM DO WE SHARE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION?
share.summary: In Short: We only share information with the technical providers necessary for the app to function (Google Firebase, Google AdMob), the app stores (Google Play, App Store) for purchase management, and if required to do so by law. We never sell your data to third parties.

keep.heading: HOW LONG DO WE KEEP YOUR INFORMATION?
keep.summary: In Short: We keep your information for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this notice, unless a longer retention period is required by law.
keep.detail: Messages sent through the contact form are kept for as long as needed to process your request, then archived or deleted. Aggregated statistical data (Firebase Analytics) is retained according to Google Firebase's default settings.

rights.heading: WHAT ARE YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS?
rights.summary: In Short: Depending on your country of residence, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, to withdraw your consent to processing, and to object to certain types of processing.
rights.detail: You can withdraw your consent to audience measurement and personalized advertising at any time from the privacy settings available in the app (Settings > Privacy).

dnt.heading: "DO-NOT-TRACK" FEATURE CONTROLS
dnt.text: Most web browsers and some mobile operating systems and applications include a "Do-Not-Track" ("DNT") feature or setting you can activate to signal your privacy preference. No uniform technology standard for recognizing and implementing DNT signals has been finalized as of yet. As such, we do not currently respond to DNT browser signals. If a standard for online tracking is adopted that we must follow in the future, we will inform you about that practice in a revised version of this privacy notice.

usRights.heading: DO UNITED STATES RESIDENTS HAVE SPECIFIC PRIVACY RIGHTS?
usRights.summary: In Short: If you are a resident of the United States, you have certain specific rights regarding access to your personal information, depending on the state in which you reside. You may exercise these rights by contacting us at the address indicated below.

updates.heading: DO WE MAKE UPDATES TO THIS NOTICE?
updates.summary: In Short: Yes, we will update this notice as necessary to stay compliant with relevant laws.
updates.detail: We may update this privacy notice from time to time. The updated version will be indicated by an updated "Revised" date and will be effective as soon as it is accessible. If we make material changes to this privacy notice, we may notify you either by prominently posting a notice of such changes or by directly sending you a notification. We encourage you to review this privacy notice frequently to stay informed about how we are protecting your information.

contact.heading: HOW CAN YOU CONTACT US ABOUT THIS NOTICE?
contact.text: If you have questions or comments about this notice, you may email us at <mailLink>othmeneb@gmail.com</mailLink>.

access.heading: HOW CAN YOU REVIEW, UPDATE, OR DELETE THE DATA WE COLLECT?
access.text: Depending on the laws applicable in your country, you may have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you, to have it corrected, or to have it deleted. To do so, simply contact us at <mailLink>othmeneb@gmail.com</mailLink>; we will process your request as promptly as possible.

intro.title: Why correct your recitation?
intro.paragraph1: Reciting correctly is not just about reading the phonetics accurately: following the rules of Tajweed (elongations, letter connections, articulation points) often requires outside feedback to identify what needs to be improved.
intro.paragraph2: With Noor Phonetic Quran, you can record yourself directly in the app and receive personalized correction, without needing to find a teacher who is always available.
intro.paragraph3: This recitation correction fits naturally into your Quran learning alongside the Tajweed module and the memorization (Hifz) journey: you identify your pronunciation mistakes, correct them using the illustrated rules, and then review them during your memorization sessions to make lasting progress, verse after verse.

intro.title: What is a Khatma?
intro.paragraph1: Khatma refers to reading the Quran in full, from beginning (Al-Fatiha) to end (An-Nas). Many Muslims complete a Khatma during the month of Ramadan, but it can also be undertaken at any time of the year, over the duration of your choice.
intro.paragraph2: Finishing the Quran requires consistency: without a reading plan or tracking, it's easy to lose track or give up along the way. That's exactly what Noor Phonetic Quran's Khatma feature solves.

items.question: What is a Khatma of the Quran?
items.answer: A Khatma refers to reading the Quran from beginning to end, usually completed over a set period (often during the month of Ramadan, but also throughout the year).

items.question: How do I plan a Khatma with the app?
items.answer: Choose a number of days to finish the Quran (for example 30 days for Ramadan), and the app automatically calculates your daily page goal and tracks your progress day after day.

hero.title: Quran Tajweed Rules: Colored and Detailed Learning
hero.subtitle: The Quranic text is displayed colored and annotated according to the rules of Tajweed, along with detailed guides on articulation points, Noun Sakinah, and the rules of stopping and resuming.

intro.title: Why Tajweed matters
intro.paragraph1: Tajweed is the set of rules that ensure correct recitation of the Quran: precise pronunciation of each letter, elongations, letter connections, and places where one may stop or resume reading. Reciting without observing Tajweed can alter the meaning of the text.
intro.paragraph2: Noor Phonetic Quran makes these rules visible and understandable, with colors while reading and detailed guides to deepen each concept.

items.title: Colored and annotated text
items.description: colors and annotations guide your recitation directly on the Quranic text, according to the correct rules of Tajweed.

items.title: Articulation points (Makharij)
items.description: learn the correct pronunciation of each Arabic letter from its articulation point, with anatomical diagrams.

items.title: Noun Sakinah and Tanween
items.description: the 4 rules governing Noun Sakinah and Tanween (Izhar, Idgham, Iqlab, Ikhfa) explained and compared visually.

items.title: Waqf et Ibtidā
items.description: the rules that identify where stopping and resuming recitation is permitted, to preserve the meaning of the text.

items.answer: Tajweed is the set of rules governing the correct pronunciation of the Quran: elongations, letter connections, articulation points of letters, and rules for stopping and resuming recitation.

items.question: How does the app teach Tajweed?
items.answer: The Quranic text is colored and annotated according to the rules of Tajweed while reading, and detailed guides explain each rule: articulation points, Noun Sakinah and Tanween, as well as the rules of Waqf and Ibtida.
